svg.title: Flat board and a volume
svg.desc: Schematic comparing flat kinusaiga on a foam board with kimekomi on a three-dimensional form, using the same leaf. Not a photograph and not an item for sale.
svg.text: The same leaf. Only the support changes.
Little depth. A picture on one face.
Often carved wood. Not a flat picture.
Same gesture: tuck cloth into a groove. Different object.
This site teaches the flat board only.
The volume is a diagram of the difference, not a doll for sale.
